# The problem

## Three systems, one collection

- The ILS, the digital repository and a Special Collections spreadsheet each hold part of the record.
- They disagree on 1,840 items. Most conflicts are dates, not titles.
- Nobody can say which system is right without opening all three.

## What we heard

> Show me the conflicts, side by side, before I decide.

Twelve conversations, four departments, one request.

# The method

## Listen, trace, tune, echo.

| Week | Movement | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Listen | Written record of current workflows |
| 2 | Trace | Record lineage for each system |
| 3 | Tune | Working prototype, first review |
| 4 | Echo | Handover, documentation, second review |

## What you get

1. A prototype that runs on your infrastructure.
2. Source code with a plain README.
3. Two review sessions with the cataloging team.

## Thank you. {.te-closing}

Tell us about the system you wish you had.
